description: Per-rule warning baseline for the anti-slop ratchet.  CI fails if any rule's warning count increases above its baseline.  On a pull request the comparison is the merge commit against this file on the base branch, so a branch that is only behind does not regenerate this file.  Raising a count here does not make that check pass.  An increase requires the pull request label allow-lint-baseline-increase, and each raised count must equal the measured merge-commit count.  Decrease the baseline only by cleaning up violations, then run `node scripts/check-lint-baseline.mjs --update` to tighten it.
